data.title: Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27 award
data.summary: The Global Talent Scholarship Foundation wrote on 5 September 2026 to award you a scholarship for 2026/27. You will receive €450.00 per month from October 2026 to September 2027, and your first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.
data.explanation: Congratulations: you have been awarded a scholarship of €450.00 per month for 12 months, paid by bank transfer around the first working day of each month. To keep it, stay enrolled full-time at Hochschule Musterstadt and upload your enrolment certificate each semester. Submit a progress report, countersigned by your supervisor, by 15 December 2026. Report changes of address, bank details or study status within two weeks, and report other scholarships before accepting them. The letter says the stipend is generally tax-free, so keep it for your records. The foundation also plans an Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7 November 2026, with a separate invitation to follow.
data.tax_note: The letter says the scholarship is generally tax-free under § 3 No. 44 EStG. Keep it as proof of the income when preparing your tax return.
